title: The Art of Magic: The Gathering - Ixalan

paragraphs.text: The Art of Magic: The Gathering - Ixalan is an art book that was published under Viz Media 's Perfect Square imprint in January 2018.

The substantial 240-page tome will feature dozens of full-color works by an impressive array of talented artists, including Christine Choi, Daarken and Titus Lunter, and will be complemented with additional in-depth lore by bestselling author and Magic: The Gathering Senior Game Designer James Wyatt . The Art of Magic: The Gathering – Ixalan invites fans to set sail for the uncharted jungles of Ixalan , where dangerous beasts , magnificent ruins, and lost treasures lie waiting to be discovered. Saddle up your dinosaur mount and brave the unknown as you search the plane for a prize forgotten by history... until now!
